caveats: ⚑ S1 trigger 'Activates when Prediction status ends' has no engine primitive. Prediction is a 10s self status opened by her OWN burst cast; the team Full Burst window is also 10s and opens moments after that cast, so Prediction end ≈ Full Burst end. Modeled as fullBurstEnd + ownBurstGate:'cast' (so it never fires on rotations where another Burst II casts). Real Prediction end is slightly EARLIER than FB end (by the cast→FB-open gap) — pin from footage.

⚑ 'Removes Heat Emission under certain conditions' is deliberately vague in the prose. HYPOTHESIS: the condition is reloading to max ammunition — S1 dumps 100% of ammo at Prediction end, forcing an immediate (half-speed) reload, and the sibling Overheat I line uses that exact removal wording. Self-side modeled with removeOnReload:true; ally-side cannot use removeOnReload (it would strip on each ALLY's own reload, not on Grave's), so the ally buffs carry a ⚑ durationSec instead.

⚑ Heat Emission window length = Grave's slowed reload. Derived, not measured: reloadFrames 81 (1.35s) ÷ 0.5 reload ratio ≈ 2.7s. Both the ally burstGen/pierce buffs (durationSec 2.7) and the 2%/sec self heal (ticks 3) ride this derivation.

⚑ Overheat II/III are counted 'after Prediction takes effect' — a burst-scoped attack counter the engine does not have. hitCount is cumulative from battle start, so counts 30/60 are a PROXY; the fbGate:'inFb' + ownBurstGate:'cast' pair restricts application to her own Prediction window but the exact in-window arrival frame will not match the real 30th/60th landed attack.

⚑ Overheat chain dependency ('While in Prediction and Overheat I/II status') is modeled implicitly: all three Overheat buffs carry removeOnReload:true, and the S1 forced reload at Prediction end strips the whole chain together. The engine does not enforce II-requires-I; if a future change lets II/III apply without I the model over-credits.

⚑ Cadence tuple (AR pulls/sec, reloadFrames 81) is datamine-sourced and unreliable; it drives BOTH the hit-threshold arrival times (15/30/60) and the Heat Emission window length, so two ⚑ estimates share one unverified input.

hasPierce is deliberately FALSE: Pierce is a 10s burst-window grant, encoded as a gainPierce effect. A whole-fight boolean would over-credit both her own 52.8% and the team's 39.98%/48.4% Pierce Damage buffs.

'Current HP ▼ 1% every 1 sec' is skipped, not ignored: v1 models no HP pool and the boss deals no damage, so self-drain has no offensive or survival consequence. It is NOT a heal/shield/DEF tandem line.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of the kit prose only (S6 cross-family). Structure: burst opens Prediction (10s unlimited ammo + Pierce + self Pierce Dmg/Crit Rate) plus a 10s team Attack Damage / Pierce Damage / +3 Max Ammo aura. S2 is a three-tier Overheat ramp (15 landed attacks → ATK 15.48%; 30 in-Prediction → ATK 20.66%; 60 in-Prediction → Attack Damage 30.8%), all removed on reload-to-max. S1 fires at Prediction end: it dumps the whole magazine and halves reload ratio (a WEAPON-STATE damage line — it costs real shots, do not skip it), and during the resulting Heat Emission window grants the team Burst Gauge speed 38.96% + Pierce Damage 48.4% and self-heals 2% Max HP/sec. The Prediction-end trigger, the Heat Emission removal condition, and its window length are all proxies — see caveats.

flags.reasoning: 'Activates when Prediction status ends' has no engine primitive. Prediction = 10s self status opened by her own burst cast; the team Full Burst window is also 10s and opens shortly after that cast, so Prediction end lands slightly BEFORE FB end. ownBurstGate:'cast' prevents firing on rotations where a different Burst II casts (Grave is B2 — a crown/other-B2 comp gives her no Prediction at all).
flags.recipe: Frame-count from her burst banner to the moment her magazine visibly empties / the reload bar starts, anchored to the 03:00→02:59 frame. If the offset from FB end is >~0.5s, replace with a burstCast-triggered block carrying a delay-equivalent (or request a 'statusEnd' trigger primitive).

flags.reasoning: The prose says only 'Removes Heat Emission under certain conditions'. The sibling Overheat I line spells out 'Removed upon reloading to max ammunition', and S1 itself dumps 100% of ammo — which forces exactly that reload. So reload-to-max is the strongly-implied condition. Ally-targeted buffs cannot use removeOnReload (it would key off each ally's OWN reload), so they get an explicit duration instead.
flags.recipe: Watch the ally Burst-Gauge-speed / Pierce-Damage buff icons in a recording: time from Grave's magazine emptying to icon disappearance. If the icons persist past her reload completion, the condition is time-based or something else and the ally durationSec must be re-derived from the observed window.

flags.reasoning: DERIVED, not measured: base reloadFrames 81 = 1.35s; Reload Ratio ▼50% halves reload speed ⇒ ~2.7s. Both the ally aura duration and the number of 1s heal ticks ride this single derivation, and reloadFrames is a known-unreliable datamine field.
flags.recipe: Time Grave's post-Prediction reload bar in footage (frame count ÷60). Set durationSec to the measured value and ticks = floor(measured). Cross-check against the ammo counter refilling to 60.

flags.reasoning: The kit counts attacks landed AFTER Prediction takes effect — a burst-scoped counter the engine lacks (hitCount is cumulative from battle start). At a typical AR cadence (~12 pulls/s) 30 attacks ≈ 2.5s and 60 ≈ 5.0s into the 10s unlimited-ammo window, so both tiers realistically land every Prediction. The gates confine application to her own window, but the exact arrival frame is a proxy and depends on the ⚑ cadence tuple.

If the real arrivals differ materially from the cumulative-hitCount arrivals, replace with burstCast-triggered buffs whose durationSec = 10 − (measured arrival), accepting the front-loaded/back-loaded shape difference.
